decision.reason: The theorem advertises epsilon=1 while its supplying algorithm originally excluded that rational input. This nonfatal interface inconsistency is repaired in the assigned supplier by permitting p_epsilon=q_epsilon; the theorem carrier needs no change. The kernel supplier and perturbation proof cover 0<epsilon<=1. Their relative kernel error is at most 10sqrt(300)epsilon/2048; the four implementation budgets add at most epsilon/512 relative error. Their sum is below 0.09epsilon, giving norm(u)>1/(4kappa), the amplification lower bound and normalized distance <epsilon also at epsilon=1. The domain-tag projection fixes the ideal dilation target and contracts the error; actual adjoints are covered by the clean-subspace hybrid. Successful branches preserve the actual good ray, not an independent fresh preparation.
